raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since the 2026-01-15 CRM migration, 58 customers carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of names. raw_region_map provides the code-to-name mapping (01 WEST, 02 EAST, 03 NORTH, 04 SOUTH), so silver_customers should translate codes through that map rather than passing them through raw.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(m.region_name, upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
